outcome.Summary: Implemented the full SPEC.md in package `expr` (expr/lexer.go tokenize, expr/ast.go, expr/parser.go recursive-descent parser, expr/eval.go evaluator + builtins, expr/error.go, expr/expr.go public API). Precedence follows the spec exactly (right-assoc `^` above unary so `-2^2=-4`, `2^-1=0.5`, `2^3^2=512`; right-assoc ternary), with short-circuit `&&`/`||`/`?:`, compile errors for unknown functions/arity and syntax issues, and runtime errors (unknown variable, division by zero, sqrt of negative, non-finite result) all as *Error with spec'd positions/messages. Wrote expr/expr_test.go with ~100 cases covering literals, precedence, truthiness, functions, all error messages/positions, Vars(), and Program reuse; `go vet ./... && go test -count=1 ./...` passes and the code is gofmt-clean.
